comparison.objective: Manually close a powered valve actuator after power loss by engaging its override clutch.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a declutch lever while turning a handwheel until a clutch dog engages, then continue turning.
comparison.success_condition: Clutch engaged and valve within 5 degrees of its closed stop for three seconds.
comparison.reason: Although both involve a stateful mechanism and rotation, this tests bimanual clutch engagement and valve closure, not fine tool-mediated unlock-adjust-relock work or tuning from impact response.
